svg.title: Corrosion Selection Matrix
svg.desc: Historical source costs, RMB/tonne water. Acidic CO₂/H₂S: titanium alloy + imidazoline inhibitor; alternative epoxy + alkaline neutralisation; 1.5-3.0. High chloride: duplex steel + impressed-current protection; alternative molybdate blend; 2.0-4.0. Oxygen: vacuum deaeration + passivating inhibitor; alternative sodium sulphite + ceramic coating; 0.8-1.5. Microbial: chlorine dioxide + antimicrobial coating; alternative UV + quaternary-ammonium flushing; 1.2-2.5. Under-deposit: PESA antiscalant + dynamic pH control + eddy-current cleaning; alternative chemical cleaning + polishing; 1.0-2.2. Source-listed options and indicative costs, not prescriptions or current prices.
